description: List every blockchain SwiftNodes serves (125+ chains, one API key for all). Returns name, slug, chain ID, category, and docs page per chain. Use before get_chain if unsure of the exact chain name.

evm_only.description: If true, only EVM chains are returned.

query.description: Optional name/slug substring filter, e.g. 'base' or 'zksync'.

name: list_chains
